integrity: MB-homogeneity of the disjoint union is prior and explicitly credited. The decorated-partition orbit classification, reachability order, and exact enumerators are the claims reviewed here. Finite computation is used only as verification.
scientific_limitations: The result describes finite tuple-orbit reachability under bimorphisms, not the full algebraic structure of the bimorphism monoid. An equivalent finite-action description could exist under different transformation-monoid terminology.
title: Oriented-partition reachability for the bimorphism monoid of a countable union of random tournaments
